what_it_is: Almost all armor and badges. All accesories. Both in level 44. Great status. Lots of items. Saved in Bowser Castle.

note: The EEPROM payload is in emulator byte order (the order mGBA, VBA-M and a raw .sav use; text such as "ADLEZBGA" reads backwards per 8 bytes), not the GameShark order, so mGBA's import (which reverses each 8-byte block) scrambles it; taken as is instead, mGBA shows it: 2481 coins, 15:08, levels 44/44, Bowser's Castle Great Door.
